posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
A common idea out there, but I wanted to make my own in a way that works well for me and my project. This adds a sound effect to the player's character as they walk and run.
HOW TO USE:
Select which sound effect you want to use from the SE folder. Setup the values for volume and pitch, as well as the frequency for walking and running. (Frequency of 1 = every step, frequency of 2 = every other step, etc.)
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.
